finding.text: The task folder has no requirements.md (only past-work.md, session.jsonl, review/diff.patch), and session.jsonl line 1 cuts the owner's voice ask off at "Chat v"; a fresh agent cannot tell what was asked, so "met?" cannot be checked. Write the ask (the owner's words) into requirements.md.

public/framework/audio/Recite/readme.md (line 37, also line 16 and the Test line 41) is now stale: it says ▶/⏸ and ↺10 are "under every assistant reply bubble", but ReciteBubble.css:31-33 hides them until the bubble is tapped (is-selected) or playing, and ↺10 until it has played. Add the selection rule and the new `select()`; the test line should mention the idle-hidden and both-shown checks.

The diff mixes two jobs: the V1.2 scroll fix (ChatV1Dot2.css:5-7) and a Recite control-visibility change (ReciteBubble.css/js/test) that shows nothing in the ask as far as the folder records. If the owner did not ask for it, move it to its own task; if they did, say so in requirements.md.

public/framework/ext/Chat/v1-2/readme.md does not mention the log-height rule (`.chat-v1-2 .chatbox-log { max-height: none }` and the `.sov-chat` height `max(22em, calc(100dvh - 20em))`), so the sessions-page sizing lives only in the CSS; add a line stating which host sets which height.

ReciteBubble.js:43-46 adds a second click listener per host beside the existing tap listener (line ~45); the select could be folded into that one. Also public/framework/audio/Recite/ai/log.jsonl is untracked and only its files.jsonl entry changed — check it is meant to be committed.
No screenshots or layout.json are in review/; the 22em / 100dvh-20em height at 400 and 1920 on the sessions page is unverified from this folder.

The task folder has no requirements.md (it holds only past-work.md, session.jsonl, inbox.jsonl, review.jsonl, review/diff.patch), so "does it do what the owner asked" cannot be checked, and session.jsonl line 1 cuts the owner's voice ask off at "Chat v". Write the owner's ask into requirements.md.

review/diff.patch does not match this task (v1-2-scroll-fix). It removes the 🧠 mark from ChatV3 (ChatV3.js:112-120 and :191-194, ChatV3.css:34, v3/readme.md:49) and contains nothing about the V1.2 scroll fix or Recite. Either the wrong diff was captured or ChatV3 work was mixed in. Regenerate the diff from branch worktree/v1-2-scroll-fix, or split the ChatV3 change into its own task.

The diff is not in the main tree: public/framework/ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.js:115 and :193 and ChatV3.css:34 still draw the 🧠 `chat-v3-brain`. State which branch carries the ChatV3 change and whether it has landed.

Removing 🧠 from V3 replies also changes V2, which extends ChatV3 and reuses `reply()`. ext/Chat/v2/readme.md and ChatV2.test.mjs:55-100 still describe the 🧠 as V2's own mark. Check them against the new reply, and note in the v3 and v2 readmes that Replies no longer carry the brain avatar.

Stale doc already flagged in review.jsonl and not fixed in the diff: audio/Recite/readme.md (lines 16, 37 and 41) still says the controls sit "under every assistant reply bubble", but ReciteBubble now hides them until the bubble is tapped or playing. Also ext/Chat/v1-2/readme.md says nothing about the log-height rule (`max-height: none`, `.sov-chat` height `max(22em, calc(100dvh - 20em))`). The prior findings 2 and 4 remain open.
There are no screenshots or layout.json in review/, so the sessions-page height at 400 and 1920 is unverified from this folder.

ReciteBubble.js adds a second click listener per host beside the tap listener; folding the select into the existing one would be simpler. Check that public/framework/audio/Recite/ai/log.jsonl is meant to be committed.
